Do you hear that? The constant gunfire? The shelling? And they tell the world there is a ceasefire? There is no pause. No reprieve. No safety for Palestinians in Gaza. On October 11, our team visited families whose tents had been burned, leaving them without shelter once again. Even as we filmed, heavy gunfire echoed around us. This is the reality of life in Gaza. Families who have lost everything continue to live under the threat of violence, yet refuse to be driven from their land. This is what steadfastness looks like. Sumud. A determination that is difficult to comprehend unless you understand what it means to face the loss of your homeland. They have burned their shelters, destroyed their neighborhoods, and displaced them again and again. But they have not broken their connection to Palestine. They are not leaving. They are not surrendering their right to exist on their land. Help support them. The Sameer Project is one of the only organizations that delivers aid in these danger zones. Some lands are known for their beauty, others for their history. But Palestine carries a story that stretches far beyond its borders, a story written in ancient streets, olive trees and generations of people who call it home. This is Palestine! Welcome to Palestine! 🇵🇸❤️ Located in the Middle East, Palestine consists of two territories: the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, along the eastern Mediterranean. In Bethlehem, the birthplace of Jesus, the ancient Church of the Nativity stands as one of Christianity's most important historic sites. Then there's Jericho, one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, where thousands of years of human history can still be felt. In Nablus, traditional markets, historic architecture and the famous Palestinian knafeh reveal a culture rich in flavour and tradition. And in Battir, ancient stone terraces, olive groves and beautiful landscapes tell the story of generations connected to the land. But Palestine is more than ancient buildings and beautiful scenery. It is a place of deep cultural traditions, distinctive embroidery, traditional music, delicious food and remarkable hospitality. From its historic cities to its Mediterranean coastline, Palestine carries a heritage that deserves to be discovered and remembered. So, if you could experience one place in Palestine, where would you go? Drop the Palestinian flag in the comments, and follow Travel Scope for more incredible stories from around the world! #Palestine #FreePalestine #Gaza #VisitPalestine #PalestinianCulture

AVERTISSEMENT : cette vidéo contient des images difficiles. Pendant plusieurs jours, nous avons suivi le quotidien d’une jeune médecin dans la bande de Gaza. L’accès libre à l’enclave palestinienne reste interdit à la presse internationale depuis le 7 octobre 2023. Impossible pour nous de la rencontrer en personne, tout comme les autres intervenants que vous allez voir dans ce reportage. C’est donc grâce à des collègues gazaouis que la Dre Haneen Al-Dayeh expose sa réalité un peu plus d’un an après une entente de cessez-le-feu entre Israël et le Hamas issue d’un plan de paix annoncé par le président des États-Unis, Donald Trump.  Ce TikTok est une petite portion du reportage long disponible sur le site de Radio-Canada, reportage diffusé dans la toute nouvelle émission « Pendant que la Terre tourne » animée par Céline Galipeau.
